gloss: to cut into; to charge in; to probe sharply

definitions.gloss: to cut into; to make a cut in
definitions.explanation: To cut deep into something with a blade, or cut a notch into it.

definitions.gloss: to charge into; to attack (the enemy); to probe (a question) sharply
definitions.explanation: To charge into the enemy, sword in hand; figuratively, to press hard on the core of an issue in questioning or criticism.

notes:
⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The noun ⟦{切|き}り{込|こ}み→切り込み：30657_kirikomi⟧ is a cut or notch (sense 1) and a raid (sense 2).

TRANSITIVITY:
Usually 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{込|こ}む (into ~). Sense 1 also takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the thing cut (⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{込|こ}む), but 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{核心|かくしん}→核心：13105_kakushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{込|こ}む: to get to the heart of an issue
- ⟦{鋭|するど}く→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧{切|き}り{込|こ}む: to probe sharply
- ⟦{敵陣|てきじん}→敵陣：23009_tekijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{込|こ}む: to charge into the enemy
- ⟦{切|き}り{込|こ}み→切り込み：30657_kirikomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to make a cut

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む→突っ込む：07000_tsukkomu⟧: to plunge into; also to question pointedly, but more casual
